text: If Sanborn miscarved one letter, a cipher could look dead when it is not. A ciphertext autokey with a constant shift is the simplest cipher that makes the width-21 repeats.
At distance 21 the residuals at the 24 known places should all be equal; the commonest value, L, turns up only 2 times, so more than two would have to change.
Every distance, all 32 ways of using the table, every carved letter changed, deleted or doubled: nothing passes three checks, and distance 21 has no survivor at all.
